hook.text: When a car turns, the outside wheel travels farther than the inside one. They can't spin the same speed.

buildup.text: If both wheels were locked together, the car would judder and scrub its tires in every turn.

discovery.text: The differential is a gearbox between the wheels that lets them spin at different speeds.

twist.text: A basic diff sends power to the wheel with least resistance—bad when one tire is on ice.

climax.text: Limited-slip differentials solve this by locking partially, sending power where grip exists.

punchline.text: The diff lets your wheels disagree—politely.

quiz.question: What does a differential allow?
options: Wheels to spin at different speeds
